coverage.note: 1992-01-08 to 1992-12-16. All 30 meetings in the volume were read end to end, first meeting January 8, 1992 to last meeting December 16, 1992; the March 25, 1992 meeting was organizational only (officer election and department presentations) and produced no findings. No separate special meetings or site-inspection meetings were found. Scan quirks: the October 21 and December 16 meetings each appear twice in the scan (duplicate copies); each was recorded once. The June 24 meeting heading reads 'WEDNESDAY, JUNE 21, 1992' but continuation pages say June 24, 1992 and June 24 was the Wednesday; recorded as 1992-06-24. The OCR double-spaces nearly every word; quotes reproduce the spacing as printed. Conflicts recorded as printed, never reconciled: 92-006 (Feb 5) prints a penalty total of $132.50 although 2 x $65.25 = $130.50; 92-118 (Jul 29) prints a total of $50.70 although 2 x $25.32 = $50.64; 92-116 (Aug 12) gives the address as 1424-21st Ave, but the June 17 jurisdiction request for the same Application No. 9104408 gives 1426-21st Ave; 92-144 (Sep 9) gives the address as 3669-26th St, but the July 8 jurisdiction request for the same Application No. 9113985 gives 3668-26th St; 92-023 (Mar 4) first motion to reduce the penalty to 2 x $894 = $1,788 failed 1-3, then the Board adopted a $5,000.00 reduction 4-0; 92-085 was called an alteration permit in earlier items but the September 23 hearing states it is a satellite dish antenna permit. Skips of note: peddler, pushcart, taxicab, pedicab and other vehicle permits with no building address were skipped entirely (including 92-060, 92-068, 92-057, 92-121, 92-125, 92-178, 92-188, the 92-127/92-128/92-131/92-132 taxicab medallion appeals, and rehearing requests for 92-178 and 92-131); jurisdiction grants are procedural and not recorded (including the December 16 grant for 350 Bay St); the December 2 jurisdiction request for 1739-35th Ave was taken off calendar with no decision and is not recorded; rules amendments, budgets, officer elections, findings adoptions, court outcomes and executive sessions as decisions were skipped.
